meta.audit_note: Reality-check performed 2026-03-09 against source code on branch copilot/update-cache-module-docs.

findings.title: invalidatePII() not auto-integrated into PIIPseudonymizer::erasePII()
findings.claim_section: GDPR-Aware Cache Invalidation — Remaining follow-up items
findings.expected: Calling PIIPseudonymizer::erasePII(uuid) automatically triggers AdaptiveQueryCache::invalidatePII(uuid) without manual caller coordination.
findings.observed: invalidatePII() is fully implemented in adaptive_query_cache.h (line ~360). No call to invalidatePII() found in PIIPseudonymizer::erasePII().
findings.suggested_issue_title: [cache] Auto-trigger invalidatePII() from PIIPseudonymizer::erasePII() for GDPR Art. 17 compliance

findings.title: Signed invalidation messages for RedisCacheCoordinator not implemented
findings.expected: RedisCacheCoordinator validates that incoming invalidation messages carry a signed node token to prevent unauthenticated cache-flush attacks.
findings.observed: include/cache/redis_cache_coordinator.h has no signature/HMAC/node_token fields. src/cache/redis_cache_coordinator.cpp has no signature validation. Only node_id self-echo prevention is present.
findings.suggested_issue_title: [cache] Add signed invalidation messages to RedisCacheCoordinator to prevent unauthenticated cache-flush attacks

findings.title: HTTP endpoint DELETE /v1/admin/cache/pii/{pii_uuid} not implemented
findings.claim_section: GDPR-Aware Cache Invalidation — Remaining follow-up items
findings.expected: A DELETE /v1/admin/cache/pii/{pii_uuid} HTTP endpoint in cache_admin_api_handler.cpp that calls invalidatePII() and writes a GDPR audit log entry.
findings.observed: src/server/cache_admin_api_handler.cpp has no /pii/ route. invalidatePII() is only accessible via the C++ API.
findings.suggested_issue_title: [cache] Add DELETE /v1/admin/cache/pii/{pii_uuid} admin endpoint for GDPR erasure

findings.title: Unit test coverage >80% not measured or verified
findings.expected: Automated unit test coverage measurement (lcov/gcov) configured in CMakeLists.txt with >80% target enforced in CI.
findings.observed: 34 cache-related test files exist in tests/. No coverage measurement targets are configured in CMakeLists.txt. Actual coverage percentage is unknown.
findings.suggested_issue_title: [cache] Unit test coverage measurement and tracking (>80% target)
findings.note: Issue #1596 already open for this finding.

findings.title: Public header interfaces (ICache, ICacheWarmup, ICacheAdminOps, IGDPRPurgeHook, ITTLAdapter) not in include/cache/
findings.expected: Pluggable public header interfaces ICache<K,V>, ICacheWarmup, ICacheAdminOps, IGDPRPurgeHook, ITTLAdapter defined in include/cache/.
findings.observed: None of the named interfaces exist in include/cache/. Related interfaces (ICacheCoordinator, ICacheReplicationListener) are present. A generic ICache<K,V> exists in include/core/concerns/i_cache.h but is not cache-module-specific.
findings.suggested_issue_title: [cache] Define ICache<K,V>, ICacheAdminOps, IGDPRPurgeHook, ITTLAdapter in include/cache/ for pluggable architecture
findings.note: Deliberately deferred; include/cache/FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md is an interface design planning document. Concrete implementations are production-ready without these interfaces.
